Name: HSV
Desc: The "artist's model:" hue (or "tint"), saturation (or "shade") and value (or "tone").
HSVSlice: Press SELECT to use any of these colours.
HSVXTrack: Drag SELECT to change this component of the colour.
HSVXKnob: Drag SELECT to change this component of the colour.
HSVYTrack: Drag SELECT to change this component of the colour.
HSVYKnob: Drag SELECT to change this component of the colour.
HSVZTrack: Drag SELECT to change this component of the colour and see a different slice.
HSVZKnob: Drag SELECT to change this component of the colour and see a different slice.
HSVHueDegrees: Type a new value for the hue, in degrees.
HSVSaturationPercent: Type a new value for the percentage of saturation.
HSVValuePercent: Type a new value for the percentage of value.
HSVHueUp: Press SELECT, ADJUST, |!|KSELECT or |!|KADJUST to alter the hue component.
HSVHueDown: Press SELECT, ADJUST, |!|KSELECT or |!|KADJUST to alter the hue component.
HSVSaturationUp: Press SELECT, ADJUST, |!|KSELECT or |!|KADJUST to alter the saturation component.
HSVSaturationDown: Press SELECT, ADJUST, |!|KSELECT or |!|KADJUST to alter the saturation component.
HSVValueUp: Press SELECT, ADJUST, |!|KSELECT or |!|KADJUST to alter the value component.
HSVValueDown: Press SELECT, ADJUST, |!|KSELECT or |!|KADJUST to alter the value component.
HSVHueSlice: Click here to see a slice of colours with this hue.
HSVSaturationSlice: Click here to see a slice of colours with this saturation.
HSVValueSlice: Click here to see a slice of colours with this value.
